name: Sarkisian Sarkisian & Associates P.C.
about: Sarkisian Sarkisian & Associates works from Portage and Valparaiso and publishes eight attorneys, a bio page for each, and a practice that runs past injury into workers' compensation, Social Security disability and product liability.

It offers a free consultation and publishes no fee terms. Its Google listings carry 295 reviews at a five star average, the second largest count in this market, and it publishes no case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Indiana does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 301 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, 1960 to 2026. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 2 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Indiana publishes no business register we can query. INBiz answers an automated reader with a 403 and the Secretary of State's business search answers with a 202 and an empty body, which is a bot challenge, and we do not work around either. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 8 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 295 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-07-30, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

At Sarkisian Sarkisian & Associates P.C., we take care of one another. We support one another. We encourage one another. We are there to help in any way we can when one of us needs it. In the simplest terms: We are a family.

When you become our client, you become part of this family. We take care of you as if it was our mother, brother or child who suffered personal injuries or needed our help. Our team of attorneys and paralegals combine their varying skills and knowledge to work together to solve the most difficult problems. When you call, there is always someone in our office willing and able to pick up your call and answer your questions.

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

score.verdict: All 5 eligibility gates passed. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
